messages:
Alex: grabbing evening handoff — quick summary of overnight activity and current state.
Alex: around 02:12 UTC we started seeing elevated 5xxs for embedding-create calls against eu-west Dedicated pools; looks correlated with frequent autoscaler churn.
incident-bot: [ALERT] PAGE: embeddings-autoscaler-eu-west fired at 2026-03-15T02:14:08Z — 22 pages in 8m. Pager: @oncall
Priya: saw it. p95 for embedding-create jumped ~120ms -> ~1.7s during the spike window, errors mainly 502/504. digging metrics now.
Maria: kube events show repeated pod eviction/killed signals 02:09-02:18, OOM/kubelet eviction noise. runtime logs show batch worker heap growth then restart.
Jared: temporarily adjusted autoscaler floor to avoid immediate collapse: `kubectl patch hpa embeddings --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'` — that stopped the downscale-thrash.
Alex: customer impact: two Dedicated eu-west tenants saw intermittent failures (support tickets #2401, #2407). No Hosted customers affected.
Priya: rolled back runtime image on affected pools to v5.8.0 at 02:34 UTC for triage; new pods stabilized after the rollback.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-1492 created (embeddings autoscaler oscillation - eu-west). Severity: Sev2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-1492
Maria: telemetry: kv-cache hit rate steady so not cache-related. heap profile shows big allocation jump in the batch worker between 02:10-02:22.
Jared: applied conservative runtime batch cap for eu-west to reduce peak memory:
```
service.embeddings.runtime.batch_max: 64
service.embeddings.runtime.enable_qos: true
```
That reduced memory pressure and kept pods healthy after 02:40 UTC.
Priya: latencies returned near baseline by ~02:50. opening ENG-5491 to track heap profiling and follow-up analysis. assigned to Maria.
Alex: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/embeddings-autoscaler — follow sections 2-4 (autoscaler mitigation, pin/rollback, and heap capture). Also note the playbook caveat about minReplicas and kernel memory regressions.
Maria: open hypotheses: (a) memory regression in runtime image v5.8.1, (b) a noisy tenant sending very large batches. need heap dumps to confirm.
Jared: next-shift action items: 1) keep eu-west pinned to v5.8.0 for 24h; 2) schedule heap-profile capture during next low-traffic window; 3) add a short-window alert for batch worker heap delta (200MB in 5m).
Priya: added the alert and a monitoring dashboard panel for quick triage. also notified account reps and linked support tickets.
Alex: coverage for next shift: primary = Priya, secondary = Jared. if pages exceed 5/min escalate to ops lead Mike.
incident-bot: POST-MORTEM window scheduled 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Owner: Priya.
Maria: troubleshooting note to pass on: when you see scaleDown -> scaleUp < 2m pattern, raise minReplicas, check kube events for OOM or node eviction, and consider pinning runtime image.
Jared: I'll prepare a short customer-facing status update and drop into #support-ops for review tomorrow morning.
Priya: continuing watch on autoscaler.replica_changes, pod_restart_count, and the heap profiles. will hold image pin until RCA.
incident-bot: BRIDGE OPEN: #inc-2026-1492-bridge — join if page volume returns or for live triage.
Alex: handing off now. system stable for ~45m after mitigations (minReplicas raised, batch cap applied, rollback pinned). leaving detailed action items above. ping if anything flares up.
Priya: taking primary. acknowledged. :+1:
Maria: ack, will follow ENG-5491 and attach heap dumps when captured.
Jared: ack, standing by as secondary.
Alex: handoff complete. timestamp: 1779009990
